text: The landlord of the Crown Inn
why: ¶195 places them at the Crown Inn and ¶221 has Holmes speaking to the landlord as they leave, so he is plainly the Crown's landlord.
¶221 states they were out on the dark road.

text: That night: as they pass out, Holmes tells the landlord they are going on a late visit
why: ¶221 says that as they passed out Holmes told the landlord they were going on a late visit to an acquaintance, and this follows the eleven o'clock signal that night.

text: That night, a moment later: Holmes and Watson are out on the dark road, with one yellow light in front of them
why: ¶221 says a moment later they were out on the dark road with one yellow light twinkling in front of them.
